model: fixed-density fixed-shape single-temperature burn-response screen with a delayed alpha-energy reservoir
tau_E_status: Required time from the earlier steady power-balance screen; NOT an independently predicted confinement time
synchrotron_status: Baseline from workbook. T-scale exponent 2.5 is a new local screening assumption, not a recomputed radiation-transfer solution.
external_status: Upper-bound scenario: all 25 MW delivered laser power absorbed by plasma. Also run zero absorption.
alpha_retention_status: Upper bound, not a measured or orbit-derived retention. Also run 0.9.
alpha_delay_status: Baseline reservoir residence time Wfast0/Palpha_birth0 from the supplied profile; T^1.5 extension is a screening approximation.
assumptions: Ti=Te with a common evolving temperature multiplier; temperature profile shape, density, composition and magnetic geometry remain fixed.
Confinement loss is Wthermal/tau_E; no spatial transport coefficient, turbulence or MHD mode is solved.
Fuel replenishment and ash control are implicit in the fixed-composition approximation.
No RF deposition term is inserted without an absorbed-power input.
Wall heat used by secondary systems is downstream heat recovery, not an additional plasma loss term.
This is a first thermal-response calculation, not a G3/G4 pass or a full 3D plasma simulation.
